title: scRATool Downstream scRNA-seq Analysis Pipeline Parameters
description: Configuration schema for the automated scRATool Nextflow DSL2 single-cell RNA-seq downstream pipeline.

hpc_cluster_options.title: HPC, Slurm & Remote SSH Cluster Options
hpc_cluster_options.description: HPC workload manager (Slurm), partition queues, SSH remote host details, and cluster project directory location.

execution_target.description: Target execution environment: Local System, Local Slurm Cluster, or Remote SSH Cluster.

queue.description: Slurm partition / queue name for cluster job submissions (e.g. 'general', 'gpu', 'batch').

account.description: Slurm account / allocation name for cluster job billing (e.g. 'my_lab_account').

cluster_options.description: Custom resource directives passed directly to Slurm sbatch (e.g. '--account=my_lab --qos=express --time=24:00:00').

ssh_host.description: Remote Cluster SSH Address / Hostname (e.g. 'cluster.university.edu' or IP address).

remote_work_dir.description: Cluster Project Directory Location where the analysis files and results should be created.

local_system_options.title: Local System Resource Options
local_system_options.description: CPU thread count and RAM memory allocation when running locally.

max_cpus.description: Number of CPU threads dedicated for local pipeline execution (e.g. 8, 16, 32).

max_memory.description: Maximum RAM allocation limit for local system processes (e.g. '32GB', '64GB').

input_output_options.title: Input / Output Options
input_output_options.description: Input datasets, annotation maps, reference directories, and destination paths.

samplesheet.description: Path to CSV sample manifest with columns: sample_id, condition, patient_id, file_path.
samplesheet.help_text: Count matrices can be gzipped TSV/TXT (*.txt.gz), Matrix Market format (*.mtx.gz with barcodes.tsv.gz and features.tsv.gz), or HDF5 (*.h5).

annotation_map.description: Path to CSV mapping unsupervised cluster IDs to consensus biological cell types.
annotation_map.help_text: Must contain at least 'cluster' and 'consensus_annotation' columns without placeholder text.

models_dir.description: Directory containing NicheNet prior models (ligand_target_matrix.rds, lr_network.rds, weighted_networks.rds).
models_dir.help_text: If models are missing from this path, the pipeline automatically fetches them from Zenodo/GitHub.

outdir.description: Output directory where all published tables, figures, metadata, and RDS objects are saved.

experimental_design.title: Experimental Design & Biological Context
experimental_design.description: Biological baseline condition, tissue queries, and analysis seed.

reference_condition.description: Baseline reference group (e.g. CTRL/Healthy) used as denominator for all pairwise DE contrasts and comparative signaling.

tissue.description: Tissue type for scType cell annotation. Use 'auto' to let scType scan all tissues.

target_celltypes.description: Comma-separated cell types for hdWGCNA analysis. 'auto' uses the top 2 most abundant types.

seed.description: Global pseudo-random number generator seed ensuring reproducible clustering, UMAP embeddings, and sampling.

organism.description: Target organism. Determines annotation databases (org.Hs.eg.db / org.Mm.eg.db), CellChat DB, and NicheNet models.

qc_filtering_options.title: Quality Control & Gene Filtering
qc_filtering_options.description: Cellular viability thresholds, mitochondrial filter cutoffs, and variable feature counts.

nfeature_min.description: Minimum number of detected genes (nFeature_RNA) per cell.

nfeature_max.description: Maximum number of detected genes (nFeature_RNA) per cell (removes potential multiplet artifacts).

ncount_min.description: Minimum unique molecular identifiers (nCount_RNA) per cell.

ncount_max.description: Maximum unique molecular identifiers (nCount_RNA) per cell.

mt_thresh.description: Maximum allowable percentage of mitochondrial transcripts (percent.mt) per cell.

min_pct_cells.description: Minimum percentage of cells in which a gene must be detected to be retained (preserves DUX4 allowlist).

n_hvg.description: Number of highly variable genes (HVGs) selected via variance-stabilizing transformation (vst).

integration_clustering_options.title: Integration & Clustering Options
integration_clustering_options.description: Batch effect correction benchmarks, dimensional reductions, and clustering resolution sweep.

preferred_method.description: Integration algorithm choice. 'auto' selects the optimal method based on cell mixing entropy vs condition preservation.

npcs.description: Number of principal components computed and utilized for dimensional reduction.

cluster_resolutions.description: Comma-separated string of Louvain/Leiden clustering resolutions to evaluate with silhouette analysis.

default_resolution.description: Primary clustering resolution utilized for downstream annotation and differential expression.

cell_annotation_options.title: Cell Annotation Options
cell_annotation_options.description: Marker discovery cutoffs and automated annotation tuning.

marker_min_pct.description: Minimum cell fraction expressing a marker during FindAllMarkers cluster discovery.

marker_logfc_thresh.description: Minimum log2 fold-change threshold for cluster marker discovery.

top_n_markers.description: Number of top cluster-defining markers exported per cluster.

sctype_quantile.description: Confidence score quantile cutoff for scType annotation below which clusters are labeled 'Unknown'.

differential_expression_options.title: Differential Expression & Pseudobulk Options
differential_expression_options.description: Statistical testing thresholds for single-cell and pseudobulk contrasts.

de_test.description: Statistical test used for cell-level FindMarkers comparisons.

de_min_pct.description: Minimum cell fraction expressing a gene to test in cell-level DE.

de_logfc_thresh.description: Absolute log2 fold-change cutoff for defining significant differentially expressed genes.

de_fdr_thresh.description: False discovery rate (Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value) cutoff for DE significance.

pb_min_counts.description: Minimum aggregated pseudobulk counts per gene across samples for DESeq2 testing.

pb_min_samples.description: Minimum number of biological samples with non-zero pseudobulk expression.

trajectory_options.title: Trajectory & Lineage Options
trajectory_options.description: Root selection and smoothing parameters for trajectory inference.

trajectory_root_celltype.description: Keyword matching cell type used to identify root origin for pseudotime ordering (e.g. 'Satellite').

slingshot_approx_points.description: Number of points used for cubic smoothing splines along Slingshot lineages.

cell_communication_options.title: Cell-Cell Communication & Signaling Options
cell_communication_options.description: CellChat and NicheNet intercellular signaling parameters.

cellchat_min_cells.description: Minimum cell count in a subpopulation required to evaluate intercellular communication in CellChat.

cellchat_prob_type.description: Averaging method for calculating communication probability in CellChat.

nichenet_receiver.description: Keyword matching receiver cell type for NicheNet upstream ligand prioritization.

nichenet_min_expr_pct.description: Minimum expression fraction in sender/receiver cells to consider ligands and receptors expressed.

nichenet_top_ligands.description: Number of top prioritized upstream ligands to rank and plot.

nichenet_cutoff.description: Regulatory potential score cutoff for ligand-target link heatmap visualization.

cnv_and_networks_options.title: CNV & hdWGCNA Co-Expression Options
cnv_and_networks_options.description: CopyKAT aneuploidy parameters and hdWGCNA co-expression network tuning.

copykat_min_cells.description: Minimum cells per sample required to execute CopyKAT aneuploidy prediction.

copykat_genome.description: CopyKAT reference genome. Use 'hg20' for human or 'mm10' for mouse.

copykat_ks_cut.description: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test cutoff for distinguishing aneuploid from diploid single cells.

hdwgcna_k_metacell.description: Number of nearest neighbors aggregated per metacell in hdWGCNA.

hdwgcna_min_cells.description: Minimum number of cells required in a cell type per sample to construct metacells.

hdwgcna_target_metacells.description: Target number of metacells constructed per cell type.

hdwgcna_min_module_size.description: Minimum number of co-expressed genes required to define an hdWGCNA network module.

hdwgcna_merge_cut_height.description: Dendrogram branch cut height for merging correlated module eigengenes.

stage_toggles.title: Skip Flags
stage_toggles.description: Checkbox skip flags to bypass specific pipeline processing steps.

custom_biology.title: Custom Biology & Gene Panels
custom_biology.description: User-defined gene lists and biology-specific configuration. Leave empty for generic analysis.

custom_gene_allowlist.description: Comma-separated gene symbols to always retain during QC gene filtering (e.g., rare biomarkers that would otherwise be filtered out). Leave empty for standard filtering.

custom_gene_panel.description: Comma-separated gene symbols for canonical marker profiling, module scoring, and publication figure dotplots (e.g., PAX7,MYF5,MYOD1,MYOG for muscle). Leave empty to skip custom marker analysis.

scoring_gene_sets.description: Path to a CSV file with custom gene sets for AddModuleScore (columns: set_name, gene_symbol). Leave empty to skip custom pathway scoring.

trajectory_exclude_pattern.description: Regex pattern of cell types to exclude from trajectory analysis (e.g., 'Stromal|Immune'). Leave empty to include all cell types.
